caption: The drawing features a symmetrical composition centered on a stylized cross at the top, which is outlined in red with a yellow-gold interior. Blue decorative markings are present within the arms of the cross, and yellow lines radiate outward. Below the cross is a circular motif resembling a medallion or mandala, filled with repeating geometric shapes in yellow-gold, blue, and red, and bordered by concentric circles in these same colors. Flanking the central circle are two stylized tulip-like shapes in yellow-gold with maroon bases oriented outward. Between the cross and the medallion is a bow-like shape with four oval loops, outlined in blue and filled with red and yellow-gold dots, converging at a circular center with alternating colors. The background is a light tan, textured to resemble aged or weathered paper, and the entire composition is framed with a subtle brown vignette effect.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
